verdict.rationale: The documentation covers programmatic creation of API keys through management keys. It also documents workspace budgets: dollar caps (daily, weekly, monthly or lifetime) that automatically block requests once reached. Community users independently confirm per-key limits and expiry, plus hard billing caps that prevent runaway spend. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of spend limits on individual keys (that evidence is community-only), and any evidence of user-configurable request-rate limits per key.
